title: Make AI Run Tests and Fix Failures Itself
description:
Stop fixing AI's failing tests by hand! 🔁

✅ Tell AI to run pytest and read each failure
✅ Say: fix the code, not the tests
✅ Repeat until all tests pass

Day 7 of Spec-Driven AI! Next up, Day 8: Build a Mini Eval for Your Prompt.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

#shorts #ai #aicoding #vibecoding #coding #programming #python #pytest
tags: fix the code not the tests
comment: Fix code or fix tests: which does your AI do wrong? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: put "Fix the code, not the tests" in your prompt so the AI doesn't just edit a test to make it pass.
